d: Sydney and Nigel are in Milan, Italy to search for Casanova's lost Book of Love.
Sydney, Nigel and Claudia visit Athens, Greece to search the Minotaur's maze for the legendary golden twine.
Sydney and Nigel are in Cairo, Egypt and then Amsterdam. They must beat rival relic hunter Avery Ko to the Pharaoh Thutmose's diamond before it is cut up and sold.
Sydney, Nigel and Stewie Harper head to Stockholm, Sweden to find the Runestone of King Jann I of Norway.
Sydney and Nigel head to Dublin, Ireland in search of the missing crown of the last King of Ireland.
Accompanying Max the magician, Sydney and Nigel journey to Atlantic City, New Jersey in search of Hungary's lost and allegedly cursed Royal Scepter.
Sydney and Nigel go to France to look for the lost wedding vows of Josephine Pontoise and Guy de Bourdin, which would prove their heir is the rightful owner of St. Agnes Sur-Loire.
Sydney and Nigel travel to France to find the lost stones from Marie Antoinette's Crown.
